leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a reusable Angular button component with TypeScript
Configure button properties using @Input decorators for customization
Implement event handling with @Output decorators for user interactions
Apply CSS styling to create visually consistent button variants
Initialize and bind component data to control button behavior
Render the reusable button component within parent templates
Manipulate button states and appearances through property binding
